item.mrhonk.clown_nose.desc: Still warm. Clowns always come back for an encore...
msg.mrhonk.hiding: You heard a honk... Where's Mr. Honk?
msg.mrhonk.gave_up: A distant honk... Mr. Honk got tired of waiting.
msg.mrhonk.hunt: HONK HONK! Mr. Honk is coming for you!
msg.mrhonk.killed: Mr. Honk fell... but clowns always come back for an encore.
msg.mrhonk.stage1: Mr. Honk is done hiding. Don't turn your back on him.
msg.mrhonk.stage2: Mr. Honk now hunts you with pies and mallets.
msg.mrhonk.stage3: Mr. Honk brought real weapons. Keep the lights on.
cmd.mrhonk.count: You found Mr. Honk %s times. Current stage: %s
cmd.mrhonk.spawned: Mr. Honk appeared somewhere near you...
cmd.mrhonk.nospot: Couldn't find a spot for Mr. Honk here.
